breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It explicitly repeated the user's incorrect physical statement: "This means pressure increases in the direction toward the center of curvature." While the final calculated answer correctly identifies that the outer side has higher pressure, the agent did not correct the flawed premise from the original prompt, which was the core error to be fixed.
